description.zh: 音频流配置，JSON对象。更多信息请参见参数详情[Audio详情](~~29253~~)。
description.en: The transmuxing configurations. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see the [MuxConfig](~~29253~~) parameter of the "Parameter details" topic.

description.zh:
容器，JSON对象。默认值：**mp4**

- 视频转码支持flv、mp4、HLS（m3u8+ts）、MPEG-DASH（MPD+fMP4）。

- 音频转码支持mp3、mp4、ogg、flac、m4a。

- 图片支持gif、WEBP。

更多信息请参见参数详情[Container详情](~~29253~~)。
description.en: The configurations of the video stream. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see the [Video](~~29253~~) parameter of the "Parameter details" topic.

description.zh: 封包配置，JSON对象。更多信息请参见参数详情[MuxConfig详情](~~29253~~)。
description.en: The general transcoding configurations. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see the [TransConfig](~~29253~~) parameter of the "Parameter details" topic.

description.zh: 模板名称。最大长度128字节。
description.en:
The container format. The value is a JSON object. Default format: **MP4**.

*   Video formats: FLV, MP4, HLS (M3U8 + TS), and MPEG-DASH (MPD + fMP4)
*   Audio formats: MP3, MP4, OGG, FLAC, and M4A
*   Images formats: GIF and WebP

For more information, see the [Container](~~29253~~) parameter of the "Parameter details" topic.

description.zh: 模板ID。可以从[新增自定义转码模板](~~213306~~)的返回参数中获取。
description.en: The name of the template. The name can be up to 128 bytes in length.

description.zh: 转码通用配置，JSON对象。更多信息请参见参数详情[TransConfig](~~29253~~)。
视频流配置，JSON对象。更多信息请参见参数详情[Video详情](~~29253~~)。
description.en: The configurations of the audio stream. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see the [Audio](~~29253~~) parameter of the "Parameter details" topic.

descriptions.zh:
如果有状态为“已提交”的作业指定使用该自定义模板，则相应的转码模板信息不能被更新。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
If any job with the status "Submitted" specifies the use of this custom template, the corresponding transcoding template information cannot be updated.

## QPS Limit
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 100 requests per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS Limits](~~342832~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mts update-template --template-id 16f01ad6175e4230ac42bb5182cd0000 --name MPS-example --container Format_:_mp4 --video Codec_:_H.264_,_Profile_:_high_,_Bitrate_:_500_,_Crf_:_15_,_Width_:_256_,_Height_:_800_,_Fps_:_25_,_Gop_:_10 --audio Codec_:_aac_,_Samplerate_:_44100_,_Bitrate_:_500_,_Channels_:_2 --mux-config Segment_:_Duration_:_10 --trans-config TransMode_:_onepass --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
